battle.name: 南圻遠征
battle.theater: 越南南部西貢江口與城堡
battle.brief: 一八五八年九月，法西艦隊溯西貢江進攻安南，砲艇先以火力壓倒順安河口與望海樓的守台，登陸先鋒突入城內，數日內奪下西貢，成為法國在亞洲的據點。阮朝向清朝求援，兩軍於升龍郊野交戰；一八六一年法軍夜攻城堡得手，一八六二年割讓南圻三省。雷管步槍底火不熄，濕季仍可射擊。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的一方是法國與西班牙的聯合遠征軍。遠征以法國遠東海軍分艦為主體，艦隊配海軍陸戰隊步兵、水兵與海軍砲兵隊，另有工兵、通信兵、醫護人員與外籍兵團分遣隊隨行；分艦由海軍少將讓·貝納爾·熱羅比里（Jean Bernard Jauréguiberry）率領，其後由利戈·德·熱努伊（Charles Rigault de Genouilly）接掌，遠征指揮部設在南圻沿海，後方基地則設在沱瀾與西貢。西班牙以保護多米尼加會傳教區為名，派出由何塞·德·萊托納（José de Letona）率領的砲艇分隊與海軍陸戰隊參戰，與法軍共用同一批登陸目標，也分擔了攻城的兵力。另一方是越南阮朝及其宗主國清朝。阮朝的軍隊以京都禁軍與嘉定（Gia Định）、定祥（Định Tuyền）、邊和（Biên Hòa）三省的鎮戍部隊為骨幹，另有臨時徵集的民兵與徵調的民夫，防守依靠夯土城牆、角樓、壕溝與仿明式重砲，火器則以中式抬槍、鳥槍與佛郎機為主。清廷以安南為藩屬，自廣西調湘、桂兩省團練入越南，由劉成禹（Liu Chengyu）、劉長佑（Liu Changyou）等將領率領，攜帶抬槍、劈山砲與紅衣大砲協助阮朝作戰，其目標是維繫藩屬體面與雲南邊防安全，而非遠征。
countriesEn: One side was a combined expeditionary force of France and Spain. The expedition was built around the French naval division in the Far East, made up of marine infantry, sailors and a marine artillery detachment, with engineers, signallers, hospital staff and a detachment of the Foreign Legion in support. The division was led by Rear Admiral Jean Bernard Jauréguiberry and afterwards by Charles Rigault de Genouilly, with the expedition headquarters on the coast of southern Cochinchina and the bases of supply at Tourane and Saigon. Spain came in under the declared purpose of protecting the Dominican missions, sending a flotilla of gunboats and marine infantry under José de Letona; the Spanish shared the same landing objectives with the French and took part of the burden of the assaults, and in return obtained guarantees for the missions and for trade. The other side was the Nguyễn court of Vietnam together with its overlord, the Qing dynasty. The Vietnamese army rested on the capital guards and the garrisons of the three provinces of Gia Định, Định Tuyền and Biên Hòa, supplemented by hastily raised militia and conscripted carriers. Its defence relied on rammed-earth walls, corner towers, ditches and imitations of Ming heavy guns, while its small arms were Chinese-type gingals, matchlock arquebuses and swivel guns. The Qing court treated Annam as a tributary, and moved Hunan and Guangxi provincial levies into Vietnam under such commanders as Liu Chengyu and Liu Changyou, with gingals, rock-splitter guns and red-cannon batteries; their object was to save the face of the tributary system and the security of the Yunnan frontier, not to wage a distant campaign.
people: 法方的核心人物是海軍少將讓·貝納爾·熱羅比里，他率遠東分艦策動了對南圻的第一次攻擊，該分艦在他之後不久改由利戈·德·熱努伊指揮；熱努伊於一八五九年率法軍在升龍作戰，四月重奪西貢城，五月在升龍西郊嘉維（Cầu Giấy）擊敗越南與清軍聯隊，此役之後晉升上將，一八六一年主持強攻西貢城堡的法方指揮官卡斯蒂內（Charles de Castelnau）則以攻城部署與縱隊突進著稱。西班牙方面由何塞·德·萊托納率領砲艇隊與海軍陸戰隊，參加西貢與沱瀾的作戰及一八六一年的攻城。越方最具影響力的是皇帝阮福（嗣德，Tự Đức）：他在西貢陷落後接受一八五八年九月的條約，其後又反悔，令法國得以再啟戰端；西寧王阮福成（Nguyễn Phúc Thành Thái）主持城防，並在往後兩年多的圍城期間留居城堡之內，成為談判中最有分量的越方人物；阮維新（Nguyễn Tri Phú）於一八五九年率阮朝大軍北援，在嘉維戰敗後傷重，同年十月不治；嘉定守將張定（Trương Định）則於一八六一年一月以火船與火箭夜襲法軍砲艇隊，予法軍重創，自己亦因傷勢過重而亡。清方在越南的指揮核心是廣西方面的劉成禹與劉長佑，兩人以團練方式將湘桂兵力一批批送過邊境。巴黎外方傳教會的教士與南圻商人代表是推動開戰的另一半力量：前者要求保護教產與傳教自由，後者要求通商口岸與法國的護商權，這些要求同時構成了法國向安南施壓的藉口。
peopleEn: The central figure on the French side was Rear Admiral Jean Bernard Jauréguiberry, who led the Far East division and set in motion the first attack on Cochinchina; not long afterwards the division passed to Charles Rigault de Genouilly, who campaigned in Tonkin in 1859, retook Saigon in April and in May defeated the joint Vietnamese and Chinese army at Cầu Giấy west of the Red River delta, a victory after which he was promoted to admiral, while the French commander of the storming of the Saigon citadel in 1861, Charles de Castelnau, was known for his siege deployments and his columns of assault. On the Spanish side José de Letona led the gunboats and the marine infantry that took part in the operations at Saigon and Tourane and in the assault of 1861. The most influential Vietnamese was the emperor Nguyễn Phúc (Tự Đức), who accepted the treaty of September 1858 after Saigon had fallen and then reneged on it, giving France her pretext to renew the war. Nguyễn Phúc Thành Thái, Prince of Tây Định, directed the defence of the city and remained inside the citadel through the more than two years of the siege that followed, making him the weightiest Vietnamese figure in every negotiation. Nguyễn Tri Phú led the Nguyễn army north to relieve the capital in 1859 and, after his defeat at Cầu Giấy, died of his wounds in October of that year. Trương Định, the governor of Gia Định, struck the French gunboats with fire rafts and rockets in January 1861, did the French serious damage, and did not survive his own wounds. The core of Qing command in Vietnam was Liu Chengyu and Liu Changyou on the Guangxi frontier, who fed Hunan and Guangxi levies across the border in batches. The missionaries of the Paris Foreign Missions Society and the merchants of Cochinchina were the other half of the pressure that produced the war: the first demanded protection for mission property and freedom of preaching, the second free ports and the guard of French commerce, and these demands together supplied France with her pretext for putting pressure on Annam.
kits: 本卡的雷管步槍是法國陸軍在一八四〇年前後定裝的制式火槍，在南圻遠征中扮演的是登岸先鋒與守備部隊的骨幹火器。雷管擊發不需要火繩與火石的火星，底火在雨季的濕氣與海邊的鹽霧中仍能打響，這正是九月作戰以及隔年雨季再戰時最實際的好處；槍身配紙包彈，射速約每分鐘兩至三發，有效射程約二百至三百米。它同時有明顯的弱點：一名士兵的背包與皮盒只能攜帶有限數量的彈藥，後膛每發必清理，而安南的雨季與水田稻地極不利於維持隊形，這就是法軍從來不靠步兵縱隊決定戰局的原因。戰役中真正壓倒守方的是砲：登陸前由淺吃水砲艇沿江射擊城牆與砲台，攻城時把艦上火炮與二十四磅攻城砲移上陣地，一八六一年夜攻城堡時以約六門攻城砲與一門大口徑臼砲集中轟擊西南角，並以短身管榴彈砲與手投炸藥包對付城牆後的密集守軍。守方的火器明顯落後：越南與清軍配備的是中式火繩抬槍、鳥槍、佛郎機與仿明式紅衣大砲，另備火箭與火船，並有在河道中插樁、壅塞水道與築堡扼守城門的土辦法。運輸與補給同樣決定成敗：人員彈藥靠淺吃水砲艇、舢板與郵船沿海路與河道運送，岸上用馱馬與挑夫，通信則依賴郵船與後來架設的光學電報線。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card is the standard French service musket settled in the years around 1840, and in the Cochinchina expedition it formed the backbone of the landing columns and of the garrisons. Percussion ignition needed no spark from flint and steel, and the priming composition fired even in the damp of the rainy season and the salt haze off the coast, which was the plain advantage in the fighting of September and again in the rains of the following year. The ammunition was paper-wrapped, the rate of fire was about two to three rounds a minute, and the effective range ran to some two or three hundred metres. The weaknesses were just as clear: a soldier's haversack and cartridge box carried only a limited number of rounds, the breech had to be cleaned after every shot, and the rains and the flooded rice fields of Annam were the worst possible ground on which to hold a formation in order. That is why the French never left the decision of a battle to infantry columns. What actually overwhelmed the defenders was artillery. Before any landing the shallow-draft gunboats fired down the river at the walls and the batteries; for the siege the naval guns and the twenty-four-pounder siege pieces were moved into position ashore; in the night assault on the citadel in 1861 some six siege guns and one heavy mortar were concentrated on the south-western corner, while short-barrel howitzers and hand-thrown charges were used against the defenders massed behind the ramparts. The defenders' weapons were clearly out of date: the Vietnamese and the Chinese troops carried Chinese-type matchlock gingals, arquebuses, swivel guns and imitations of the Ming red-cannon, with rockets and fire rafts besides, and they had the practical expedient of driving stakes into the river channels, blocking the waterways and holding the gates with stockades. Transport and supply decided as much as the fighting: men and ammunition moved in shallow-draft gunboats, sampans and mail steamers along the coast and up the rivers, with pack animals and porters ashore, and communications depended on the steamers and later on a line of optical telegraph.
tactics: 法軍的作戰方式在四年之間經歷了兩次明顯的轉變。一八五八年是一次典型的河海機動加火力準備：艦隊封鎖西貢江與南圻沿岸，砲艇在夜裡摸到順安河口，用艦砲逐個壓制守台與望海樓的砲位，登陸部隊乘遮蔽小艇分批在城郊上岸，待江面砲火把守軍吸引到城牆一線，再由南面突入，數日內奪下城區。那次成功帶有相當的倉促成分——法軍缺攻城重砲，守軍一退卻來不及封鎖城內街道；奪城之後法方仍以條約為由撤出，改用軍艦封港，靜候下一次機會。真正決定南圻歸屬的，是一八五九年至一八六一年那種步步為營的攻法：先以艦隊切斷海路與河路，逼守軍在缺彈、缺糧、缺援的狀況下消耗，再用攻城砲與臼砲在城牆西南角開出缺口，於夜裡以縱隊投入，奪取砲台後迅速清掃城內各區，最後圍城、築壘、逼降。一八六二年之後的重心已不是攻城，而是搜捕與清剿：法軍以水陸並進的縱隊沿西貢河、邊和水道與湄公河支流推進，設置據點切斷各城之間的聯繫，配合小股騎兵與武裝偵察隊搜尋殘部。守軍的戰術則始終停留在防禦思維：以城堡為核心佈置外壕與木樆，在江面佈火船與浮障，密集使用火箭與抬槍封鎖登岸點，巷戰倚仗屋頂與城樓的射孔。他們的弱點是各城指揮互不統一，後方鄉村不能提供持續的兵員與糧食，一旦城堡失守，防守即告瓦解。
tacticsEn: The French method changed twice in the four years. The campaign of 1858 was a classic combination of movement by river and sea with fire preparation. The squadron blockaded the Saigon River and the coast of Cochinchina, the gunboats worked up to the Thuan An mouth by night and used their guns to silence one battery and one position after another along the walls of Thủ Đài and Hiển Hải Lâu, and the landing troops came ashore in covered boats in successive groups, waiting until the fire from the river had drawn the garrison to the ramparts before pushing in from the south and taking the city within a few days. The success carried a large measure of haste in it: the French had no heavy siege artillery, and once the defenders withdrew they could not seal the streets of the town. Having taken the city they withdrew again under the terms of the treaty and held the river mouths with warships, waiting for the next opportunity. What actually decided the fate of Cochinchina was the method of 1859 to 1861: first cut the sea road and the river roads and exhaust a garrison short of ammunition, food and relief; then bring up the siege guns and mortars, open a breach in the south-western face of the walls and push in by night in columns, seizing the batteries and then clearing the town district by district; then surround, sap and force a surrender. After 1862 the centre of gravity was no longer the siege but the manhunt and the sweep: columns moving by water and land pushed up the Saigon River, the Biên Hòa waterways and the branches of the Mekong, posts were set up to cut the towns off from one another, and small parties of cavalry and armed scouts tracked down the remnants. The defence stayed in a defensive frame of mind: ditch and stockade outside the citadel, fire rafts and floating barriers on the water, dense use of rockets and gingals against the landing beaches, and street fighting fought from the roofs and the tower platforms. Its weakness was that the command of the different towns was never unified, and the countryside behind them could not supply continuous men and food; once the citadel fell, the defence collapsed with it.
data: 可核對的時間點如下：一八五八年九月初，法西砲艇隊溯西貢江進攻順安河口，數日內奪取守台與望海樓一帶的陣地；同月中旬法軍攻入西貢城，九月二十一日法越雙方在西貢訂立條約，九月二十四日法軍又攻下沱瀾的越南砲台；十月法軍依約撤出西貢城區，只留軍艦封鎖。一八五九年四月法軍再度攻入西貢，五月二十一日在升龍西郊的嘉維與越南、清軍聯隊交戰；一八六一年一月，越南守軍在海河一線以火船與火箭夜襲法軍砲艇隊，二月二十二日至二十三日夜晚法西聯軍強攻西貢城堡，城堡陷落。同年下半年法軍進取順化，阮朝自此以順化為都；一八六二年六月五日西貢條約簽訂，越南割讓嘉定、定祥、邊和三省與崑島，並允許法軍在若干口岸駐兵。兵力方面，法方遠征隊以千人為量級，海軍陸戰隊與水兵數百人、法國步兵與外籍兵團分遣隊各數百人，艦艇十數艘且多為淺吃水砲艇；守方的西貢守軍與城郊營壘合計約二三千人，清廷入越南的湘桂團練亦以千計。損失方面，一八六一年攻城法軍陣亡與受傷合計近百人，一八五九年嘉維之戰法軍亦折損數十人；越軍與清軍的傷亡數字各方記載互有出入，只能確定城堡陷落時守軍大部被俘。整場戰役自一八五八年九月起至一八六二年六月止，前後約三年九個月。
dataEn: The dates that can be checked run as follows. In early September 1858 the French and Spanish gunboats came up the Saigon River against the Thuan An mouth and within a few days took the positions of Thủ Đài and Hiển Hải Lâu; in the middle of the same month the French entered the citadel of Saigon, on 21 September the two sides signed a treaty at Saigon, and on 24 September the French took the Vietnamese batteries at Tourane. In October the French withdrew from the city under the treaty and kept only their ships to blockade the approaches. In April 1859 the French entered Saigon again, and on 21 May they fought the joint Vietnamese and Chinese army at Cầu Giấy west of the Red River delta. In January 1861 the Vietnamese struck the French gunboats with fire rafts and rockets on the Rạch Gầm-Xoài Mút line, and during the night of 22 to 23 February the French and Spanish stormed the Saigon citadel and it fell. In the second half of that year the French took Huế, and the Nguyễn court made that city its capital thereafter. On 5 June 1862 the treaty of Saigon was signed, and Vietnam ceded the three provinces of Gia Định, Định Tuyền and Biên Hòa together with Poulo Condore, and allowed French troops to be stationed at certain ports. On the numbers of men, the French expedition numbered in the order of a thousand: several hundred marine infantry and sailors, and several hundred men each of French line infantry and the Foreign Legion detachment, with a dozen or more vessels, most of them shallow-draft gunboats. The Saigon garrison and the camps outside the city together came to some two or three thousand men, and the Hunan and Guangxi levies the Qing sent into Vietnam were counted in thousands as well. On losses, the French at the assault of 1861 had close to a hundred men killed and wounded, and the French at Cầu Giấy in 1859 lost several dozen. The figures for the Vietnamese and Chinese are not consistent between sources, and all that can be said is that the greater part of the garrison was taken prisoner when the citadel fell. The campaign as a whole runs from September 1858 to June 1862, a matter of about three years and nine months.
cause: 遠征的起因是法國在遠東的商業與傳教利益同安南的封閉體制之間無法調和。一八五〇年代法國商人希望在通商口岸取得居留與經商權，天主教會則要求阮朝歸還自一八四〇年代以來被沒收的教產、保護散居各地的教民並准許傳教士自由傳教；阮朝既不承認法國的通商要求，也不接受教會的申辯，雙方摩擦在一八五五年至一八五七年間累積到教民被捕、教士被處的層面。真正把摩擦變成戰爭的，是一八五七年之後的國際局勢：英法聯軍在廣州得手，遠東的清廷正被北方與沿海的戰事牽制，巴黎當局判定此時對清廷的藩屬施壓，成功率高而成本低，於是把矛頭指向安南，藉法國傳教士與商人受損為名出兵。西班牙加入的理由與法國不同，但結果一致：西班牙以保護多米尼加會在北圻的傳教區為由出兵，取得的是教會保障與通商利益，付出的卻是分擔法國最重的攻堅任務。阮朝與清廷之間的藩屬關係，使法國的每一次推進都等於對清的挑戰：清廷無法在北方用兵之餘有效馳援安南，卻也不能坐視藩屬被奪，於是只能以有限的地方團練投入，試圖在邊境上拖住法軍。中國因素之所以在此役中格外重要，正因為它是這場遠征在宗主國一側的全部意義所在。
causeEn: The expedition grew out of the impossibility of reconciling French commercial and missionary interests in the Far East with the closed system of Annam. In the 1850s French merchants wanted residence and trading rights at the open ports, and the Catholic missions wanted the Nguyễn court to return the mission property confiscated since the 1840s, to protect the scattered congregations and to allow missionaries to preach freely. The court acknowledged neither the commercial claims nor the arguments of the missions, and the friction rose through 1855 and 1857 to the point where converts were arrested and priests executed. What turned that friction into a war was the international situation after 1857: the Anglo-French forces had carried Canton, the Qing court in the north was pinned down by the fighting on the coast and on the northern frontier, and Paris judged that pressing the Qing through their own tributary while the Qing could not answer was cheap and likely to succeed. The French therefore turned on Annam and went to war under the pretext of injuries done to French missionaries and merchants. Spain's reasons differed from France's, but the result was the same: it entered to protect the Dominican missions in Tonkin, obtained security for the church and for trade, and yet paid for it by taking the heaviest share of the assault. The tributary tie between the Nguyễn court and the Qing made every French advance a challenge to the Chinese as well. The Qing could not relieve Annam effectively while it was committing its armies in the north, yet it could not sit still and see a tributary taken away either, and so it committed limited provincial levies in the hope of holding the French at the frontier. Chinese involvement matters in this war precisely because it is the whole of the meaning the expedition carried on the side of the suzerain.
impact: 南圻的陷落改變了亞洲的地緣版圖。對越南而言，一八六二年之後的阮朝只剩清化、平陽等北方諸省與一個空殼的宗主國名號，國庫的稅收基礎、稻米出口與海上貿易都落到法國人手中，南北之間的經濟落差自此固化，後來的分治與統一之爭都帶著這段被割裂的記憶。對法國而言，這是他們在亞洲最早落地的海外根據地：一八六二年取得嘉定、定祥、邊和，一八六三年出兵柬埔寨並兼併該國，一八六七年前後把柬埔寨、寮國與南圻合為法屬印度支那，一八八四年與阮朝訂約後，越南在國際法上正式落入法國保護之下，一八八七年組成印度支那聯邦。對中國而言，安南藩屬體系在西南方向實際解體，法國在一八五八年條約中承認阮朝脫離清朝的宗主地位，清廷從此失去經由安南進入雲南與中南半島的通道，也第一次眼看見歐洲海軍可以隨意登陸並長期佔據一個藩屬國。對區域社會而言，南圻的稻米出口與法國商人帶來的商船把華人移民大批帶入堤岸一帶，華人商會、同鄉會與會館在幾十年內成為當地社會的重要一支；在軍事技術上，遠征也留下了樣板：以艦砲壓制江口、以攻城砲開缺口、以夜襲縱隊奪取砲台，再以據點與縱隊分割鄉村的戰法，被一八六三年柬埔寨之役與一八八三年以後的北征反覆沿用。
impactEn: The loss of Cochinchina redrew the map of Asia. For Vietnam, the treaty of 1862 left the Nguyễn court with nothing but the northern provinces and the name of a tributary state; the fiscal base, the rice exports and the maritime trade of the south passed to French hands, and the economic gulf between north and south was fixed from that point on, to reappear in every later argument about partition and unification. For France it was the first overseas base on Asian soil: Gia Định, Định Tuyền and Biên Hòa in 1862, the neighbour Cambodia overrun in 1863, the grouping of Cambodia, Laos and Cochinchina into the French Indochina of about 1867, and after the 1884 convention with the Nguyễn court a Vietnam that in international law stood under French protection, federated as French Indochina in 1887. For China the tributary system of Annam collapsed in the south-west; France recognised in the treaty of 1858 that the Nguyễn court was independent of the Qing, and the Qing lost both the corridor into Yunnan and the Middle Indochinese peninsula through Annam, and for the first time could watch European warships land and hold a tributary state for long. For the region as a whole, the rice exports of Cochinchina and the merchant shipping the French brought drew large numbers of Chinese migrants into the districts round the Cholon, where Chinese chambers of commerce, native associations and temples became within decades a standing part of local society. In military terms the campaign left a pattern: gunboats silencing the river mouths, siege guns opening a breach, columns of assault taking the batteries by night, and then posts and columns cutting the countryside into pieces, a pattern used again in Cambodia in 1863 and in the northward campaigns after 1883.
result: 一八五八年九月的一連串戰鬥，結果是法國以一次成功的江海突襲拿下西貢，越南在順安河口與城垣一線的守備被壓垮，望海樓與守台的砲位在艦砲與登陸步兵的配合下相繼失守；法軍一度控制全城與嘉定省，並在越都之外另立新的海軍根據地沱瀾。但法軍也清楚知道，單靠一次突襲無法長期佔有南圻：城內人口稠密、鄉村廣大而道路泥濘，防守方只要恢復士氣並切斷海路，法軍就會被釘在幾個河港裡。於是戰局進入真正的較量：一八五九年法軍再攻西貢並在升龍擊敗越清聯隊，隨後以河海封鎖與逐點攻略消耗阮朝的資源；一八六一年一月越軍的火船夜襲重創法軍砲艇隊，使法軍痛感必須用攻城砲而非登陸突擊解決問題，二月二十二日至二十三日夜的強攻因此有了艦砲與缺口配合，城堡陷落；同年下半年順化失守，阮朝遷都以求苟安，直到一八六二年六月五日才在西貢簽下條約，割讓嘉定、定祥、邊和三省與崑島，分期支付賠償，並允許法國在邊境口岸駐兵。戰術層面的結論很清楚：決定這場戰爭的不是火槍的射程與精度，而是河海機動、封鎖、攻城砲兵與補給線四者能不能配合；雷管步槍的貢獻在於雨季夜襲與城壕射擊中底火可靠，讓登岸與突擊的步兵得以維持火力，但把南圻拱手交出，靠的是砲艇與攻城砲，不是槍。
resultEn: The fighting of September 1858 ended with a successful river and sea assault by the French on Saigon. The Vietnamese defence along the Thuan An mouth and the line of the walls collapsed, and the batteries at Hiển Hải Lâu and Thủ Đài were silenced and lost one after another to the fire of the gunboats and of the infantry that came ashore. For a time the French held the whole city and the province of Gia Định, and set up a new naval base at Tourane beyond the old capital. But the French knew well that a single surprise would not hold Cochinchina for long: the towns were densely built, the countryside wide and the roads mud, and once the defenders recovered their nerve and cut the sea road the French would be pinned in a few river ports. The contest then entered its real stage. The French took Saigon again in 1859 and beat the joint Vietnamese and Chinese army in Tonkin, and then wore the Nguyễn court down by blockade and piecemeal siege. In January 1861 the Vietnamese fire rafts struck the French gunboats and did serious damage, and the French learnt that the citadel had to be taken with siege guns rather than by a landing coup; the night of 22 to 23 February was accordingly given its covering fire and its breach, and the citadel fell. In the second half of that year Huế was lost and the Nguyễn court moved there to save itself, and it was not until 5 June 1862 that the treaty was signed at Saigon, ceding Gia Định, Định Tuyền and Biên Hòa together with Poulo Condore, providing for reparations by instalment, and allowing French troops to be stationed at the frontier ports. The tactical conclusion is plain. What decided the campaign was not the range or the accuracy of the musket, but whether movement by river and sea, blockade, siege artillery and the line of supply could be made to work together. The service of the percussion rifle was that the priming fired reliably in the rains and in the fire fight over the ditches, so that the men who landed and stormed kept their fire; but southern Vietnam was surrendered to the French with gunboats and siege guns, not with muskets.
